description: This Java class serves as a configuration component within a Spring Batch context. It sets up a batch job for updating loan arrears aging information, defining beans for the job, the processing step, and the tasklet that performs the update.

classes.name: UpdateLoanArrearsAgeingConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines beans for a batch job to update loan arrears aging information

methods.name: updateLoanArrearsAgeingStep
methods.description: Creates and configures a batch Step for executing the arrears aging update tasklet

methods.name: updateLoanArrearsAgeingJob
methods.description: Creates and configures a batch Job that includes the update step, with a unique run ID

methods.name: updateLoanArrearsAgeingTasklet
methods.description: Instantiates the tasklet responsible for performing the arrears aging update
